name: Quest Pack
description: Every quest in one pack, plus a QUESTS entry in the START menu that tracks them. Includes the Glow Shard fetch quest, four Town Quests, five Branching Quests with multiple endings, and three Move Tutors: masters who spawn on quiet routes and teach your trainer a signature move (a TM you cannot craft) once you beat their team. Tracked in the QUESTS menu.
